source: host ship round without Grok Bot
note: Dry mode prints the bootstrap plan and writes nothing. The host clone is $TSV_DISPATCH_ROOT/ship-repo. Each round fetches origin/vk and hard-checks it out. It re-execs that copy only when its SHIP_ROUND_VERSION is the same or newer than the installed script. An older copy stays on the installed bootstrap. A no-UI diff whose secrets and unit-tests are green gets Gate B SKIPPED_BACKEND_ONLY success. A diff that touches UI files does not. The first round ships 1042, then 1040 at d816927d, then 1044 at 6512f9bd when those pulls are still open: labels, acceptance file, accept on that exact green head, and merge when the PR is clean. Merged pulls are skipped. Every round reads tip from origin/vk and live from the staging version sha, including when no pull is open. When tip equals live and that live SHA has no dry-run record, the round runs python3 live_accept.py run and exactly one dry run, then rings the doorbell with the verdict. A failed dry run retries only after a new live SHA or a merge. Deploy is python3 tsv_dispatch.py --batch-deploy only after a merge. A stale head is not accepted. A PR dirty only because both sides appended scripts/offline-tests.txt is marked needs-rebase and is not patched. The same live SHA does not get a second dry run. Cleanup remaining other than 0 fails. The doorbell stays silent when the failure reason repeats.

assertions.note: Accept, stale head, rebase, one dry run per SHA, cleanup, and doorbell rules.
